name: xcs
description: XCS protocol specification and reference implementation for XRPL Credentials

scripts.build: turbo run build && pnpm --dir apps/web build && pnpm --dir apps/indexer build
scripts.clean: turbo run clean && pnpm --dir apps/web clean && pnpm --dir apps/indexer clean
scripts.install:apps: pnpm --dir apps/web install --ignore-workspace --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir apps/indexer install --ignore-workspace --frozen-lockfile
scripts.lint: turbo run lint && pnpm --dir apps/web lint && pnpm --dir apps/indexer lint
scripts.test: turbo run test && pnpm --dir apps/web test && pnpm --dir apps/indexer test
scripts.test:coverage: turbo run test:coverage && pnpm --dir apps/web test:coverage && pnpm --dir apps/indexer test:coverage
scripts.test:e2e: XCS_BROWSER_E2E=0 XCS_LOCAL_PAYLOAD_STORE=0 pnpm --dir apps/web build && pnpm --dir apps/web test:e2e && pnpm --dir apps/web test:e2e:security
scripts.test:postgres: pnpm --dir apps/indexer test:postgres && pnpm --dir apps/web test:postgres
scripts.typecheck: turbo run typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/indexer typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
